name: @abpai/skills-eve-evals
description: Non-blocking behavioral-contract eval lane for the skills marketplace, running real model sessions against packaged SKILL.md dirs via Eve.

scripts.eval: bun run prepare-skills && EVE_DEV=${EVE_DEV:-0} eve eval
scripts.eval:smoke: bun run prepare-skills && EVE_DEV=${EVE_DEV:-0} eve eval smoke --strict
scripts.eval:live: bun run prepare-skills && EVE_DEV=${EVE_DEV:-0} eve eval --tag live --strict
scripts.eval:live:claude: bun run prepare-skills && EVE_DEV=${EVE_DEV:-0} EVE_EVAL_PROVIDER=anthropic eve eval --tag live --strict
